ambient_events: Low voices carry from another room and stop when they notice you, then start again, easier.
Someone has left a game of cards half-played and a mug still warm.
The air is dry and clean down here, ducted from somewhere the machine doesn't watch.
description: The heart of the operation: a long, warm common room hollowed out of an old plant sublevel and made livable by hand. Mismatched chairs ring a stove; a wall of shelves holds paper — manuals, maps, ledgers, the accumulated memory of people who refuse to keep it anywhere the Architect can read. This is a safe place, and it feels like one. The quartermaster's store lies north, the operations room east, the bunkroom south, and the way out west.
name: The Common Room
